subject: economics
title: What is Scarcity? Adventure
welcome_lead: We can't have everything. That's economics in one word. ⛏️
meta_desc: Choices & Scarcity Adventure 1 — KS3 Economics on scarcity and limited resources.
final_note: You learned what scarcity is and how it forces choices on everyone.

concepts.def: Anything used to make goods or services

walkthroughs.body_html:
Scarcity happens because we have limited stuff but limitless wants.

Time, land, oil, money — all finite. But our wishlist? Infinite. 🎯

Finite resources will run out — oil, gold, coal.

Renewable resources refill — sun, wind, trees (if we replant).

Economies must choose carefully.

Every society must decide:

  • What to produce?
  • How to produce it?
  • For whom?

Scarcity is why economics exists. 📚
